concerns.text: T040 is tagged [P] (parallel-safe) but it re-runs `code/main.py` end-to-end, regenerating all data/ and artifacts/ outputs. It is not parallel-safe with any task that reads or writes those artifacts (T039 explicitly depends on it, and any US-3 task re-run concurrently would race on shared files). Either remove the [P] tag or state that it must run exclusively.

T022, T602, and T028 depend on 'already-implemented' T019/T020/T021/T024, which have no task bodies in this document — only a one-line mention in 'Revision behavior'. A fresh implementer cannot verify these producer tasks exist or what they produce; add a brief pointer (file paths or a 'verified prior tasks' appendix) so the consumer-before-producer chain is traceable within the artifact set.
